highlight_subsections.heading: Async scheduling + Pipeline Parallelism
highlight_subsections.summary: **Async scheduling + Pipeline Parallelism** is now fully supported, delivering **30.8% E2E throughput improvement** and **31.8% TPOT improvement** (#32618).

highlight_subsections.heading: Realtime API
highlight_subsections.summary: **Realtime API**: A new WebSocket-based Realtime API enables streaming audio interactions (#33187), building on the Voxtral realtime infrastructure.

highlight_subsections.heading: RLHF workflow improvements
highlight_subsections.summary: **RLHF workflow improvements**: Native NCCL-based weight syncing API (#31943), layerwise weight reloading for QeRL (#32133), and engine pause/resume with request preservation (#32351).

highlight_subsections.heading: Unified Parallel Drafting
highlight_subsections.summary: **Unified Parallel Drafting** for speculative decoding (#32887), plus spec decode now works with structured outputs (#33374) and penalty application in Model Runner V2 (#33251).

highlight_subsections.heading: Major XPU platform overhaul
highlight_subsections.summary: **Major XPU platform overhaul**: Deprecated IPEX in favor of vllm-xpu-kernels (#33379), adding MoE (#33659), MXFP4 MoE (#33679), WNA16 (#33973), scaled_mm (#34117), and FP8 MoE (#34202) support.

highlight_subsections.heading: Deprecation & Breaking Changes
highlight_subsections.summary: * Removed BitBlas quantization (#32683) and Marlin 24 (#32688). * Removed deprecated `reasoning_content` message field (#33402). * Removed deprecated pooling items (#33477). * Removed deprecated `VLLM_ALL2ALL_BACKEND` environment variable (#33535). * Deprecated IPEX for XPU, switched to vllm-xpu-kernels (#33379). ---
